notes: Topline: mid-market B2B SaaS (customer lifecycle/product analytics). Started on Hosted API to iterate quickly; now running Dedicated POC to meet throughput predictability and VPC requirement. Product & infra care most about unit economics: need to drive per-conversation cost down for chat while keeping p95 latency <200ms. During cost optimization workshop (02/10) we walked through batching, prefix/KV caching, and quantization profiles. Workshop outcomes: - batching changes (session grouping) could reduce GPU token cost ~18-30% depending on concurrency; - prefix caching (shared KB for common product FAQs) looks like a clear 20-25% win for their query distribution; - int8/4-bit quantization tests show acceptable quality drop for reranking/embeddings workloads, but chat response quality needs A/B evaluation. Customer quote from Head of Platform: "We need predictable unit cost for our freemium tier — if inference doesn't scale economically we can't expand features." Security team: SOC2 required; SSO/SAML + KMS + audit logs non-negotiable. Next: finalize quantized model runs, produce ARR forecast under multiple reserved capacity bands, and schedule CFO exec demo. Notes style here: fragments, call paraphrases, and action items. Important: they asked for explicit cost per 1M tokens and 1M embeddings for three scenarios: hosted baseline, dedicated reserved 6mo, and dedicated reserved 12mo.

requirements_summary: Workload mix: chat (customer support assistant), embeddings (semantic doc search), reranking for search quality. Latency targets: chat p95 <= 200ms (global), embedding throughput target 30-50 qps, reranking p95 <= 250ms. Cost sensitivity: want per-conversation cost reductions via batching + caching; target effective cost < $0.0015 per chat-user-message at scale. Model preferences: open/model-variants allowed; prefer Redwood-verified performant variants; require automated fallback routing to cheaper model when latency or capacity issues. Security/compliance: SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS-managed keys, audit logs retention 1 year, EU residency for subset of PII.
